tests.scope: Real built client/server/auth and stats APIs; synthetic ended transcripts. Native collector uses deterministic event/clock regression tests; no live paid provider request.

releaseAudit.scope: Publication allow-list and bounded credential patterns; two screenshots separately reviewed visually.

screenshotScope: Two reviewed performance screenshots from the final run; other screenshots in the raw browser report are reproducible temporary output.
limitations: Client-observed throughput includes transport, proxy buffering and event-processing effects; this is not the provider internal decoding clock.
No paid model benchmark, true provider speed ranking, ten-hour soak test or user production deployment.
Dashboard restart and Pi Bridge reload are required for new native timing capture; historical missing first-output timestamps cannot be recovered.
Without reported reasoning usage, hidden pre-output work cannot be detected reliably. Reported reasoning with only later text/tool output conservatively falls back to a whole-request estimate.
A third-party final-message replacement followed by content redaction that drops symbol properties can lose an optional native sample; SDK/legacy fallback remains marked as an estimate.
